newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs to eye 130.12 before pulling back.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs to eye 130.12 before pulling back.

text.p: September BTP futures traded on LIFFE will look for a slight rally on Tuesday before breaking lower, technical analysts said.

"We have got a very oversold hourly RSI (Relative Strength Index) so we can probably see a bit of a rally coming in from that area, however it won't go far," said Anne Whitby, head of technical analysis at 4CAST.
"We've got resistance at 129.77, which was selling on Monday, then it comes in from overhead supply which begins at 130.12 which was Friday's low."
At 0748 GMT, September BTPs were at 129.71, up 0.24.
Whitby said the 130.12 area was likely to be the maximum upside for this session.

"That will probably last over the day but I am looking for a technical rally only," she said. "I would be looking for a later break of 129.25, and then we re-target the 128.75 June 2 low and the 128.60 May 30 low."
Technical analysts at an Italian bank in London said BTPs had broken out of their recent range with Monday's decline.
"Further downside is possible, with 129.00 support likely to be tested," they said in a research note.
To the upside, they said the target of an eventual bounce would be at 130.00, 10.
At the short end September Eurolire futures were at 93.26, up one basis point on the day.
Analysts said some support would be offered around 93.19, 20.
